messages:
Anika: Heads-up: running a focused least-privilege sweep next Thu for infra/payment admin roles + KMS grants. Dry-run first, owner attestation, then a soft-disable if unresolved. Low-blast intent.
Theo: +1. Please exclude oncall and emergency_access roles. They look stale by last_active but are intentional.
Rashida: Add an `impact_hint` column in CSV so teams can triage quickly. Also flag principals containing 'External' for security review.
OpsBot: Dry-run scheduled by Anika for 2026-07-08T09:00Z. Will post CSV and aged KMS grant list here.
Anika: Plan: 48h notice -> dry-run -> owner ping (slack + email) -> 72h remediation window -> soft-disable -> 48h rollback window. Len to own rollback playbook.
Theo: I'll add filter `tags:requires-manual=true` to skip automation and `exclude:oncall=true`.
Rashida: For KMS, capture cross-account grants. Quick AWS snippet I use: aws kms list-grants --key-id $KEY --query "Grants[?CreateTime<`$(date -d '90 days ago' --iso-8601=seconds)`]"
OpsBot: Dry-run complete: 39 bindings flagged, 11 aged KMS grants, 4 roles >6 members, 6 principals matched External pattern. CSV: https://redwood.internal/s/ent-dryrun/5100001111.csv
Anika: Rashida will map KMS owners, Theo will run script PR for exclusions, Len will publish rollback checklist. ProductSec please review any External principals.
ProductSec: Will review External principals and escalate any cross-account key issues. Ping if owner mapping fails and we need temporary holds.
Len: Drafting rollback steps: re-enable binding, restore KMS grant via recorded grant id, smoke test auth flows. Will post checklist in this thread.
Anika: Thanks team. Keeping this small and reversible. Ping here with any risky entries before we start.
